title: When Odisha girl Sunami shined in Malayalam mono act at Kottayam school
content: Ettumanoor: Proving that creative expression knows no linguistic barriers, Sunami Nimal, a young native of Odisha, secured second place with an 'A' grade in the Lower Primary (LP) Mono Act competition at the Sub-District School Arts Festival. She is a student at St Joseph's LP School, Punnathura. Despite hailing from another state, the talented youngster captivated both the judges and the audience, delivering a stellar performance that captured the authentic nuances and cadence of the Malayalam language. Sunami was trained for the event by Kunjumol Antony, the headmistress of St Joseph's School.
